preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 4 and 5000.
The number of edges m must be at least n and at most 3 times n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: any(b == nastya for b in bees)
postconditions.description: At least one bee must be at the same vertex as Nastya at any time.
The number of moves made must not exceed the number of vertices n.
